description.en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

description.zh: 结束时间需大于起始时间,时间跨度不得大于10小时，StartTime和EndTime都不填则默认查询当前一小时的数据；获日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the time span cannot exceed 10 hours. If you do not specify StartTime and EndTime, data for the last hour is queried by default. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. Use UTC.

description.zh: 获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. Use UTC.

descriptions.zh:
调用接口查询头条指定直播流的拉流信息。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can call this API to query stream pulling information for a specified Toutiao live stream.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 100. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-toutiao-live-play --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2017-10-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-10-10T21:00:00Z --domain example.com --stream liveStream0000 --app liveApp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeToutiaoLivePlay --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --EndTime '2017-10-10T21:00:00Z' --StartTime '2017-10-10T20:00:00Z' --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com'
